verdicts.claim: OBJECT_ID format extracts the embedded date component from MongoDB ObjectId for archival matching.
verdicts.evidence: No verbatim statement that it extracts the embedded date component.

verdicts.claim: The date field used for archival criteria cannot be modified after the online archive is created.
verdicts.evidence: You can't modify the date field once the online archive is created.

verdicts.claim: MongoDB Atlas Online Archive calculates document age using the formula: current_date > dateField + expireAfterDays.
verdicts.evidence: MongoDB Cloud archives the data when the current date exceeds the date in this database parameter plus the number of days specified through the expireAfterDays parameter.

verdicts.claim: The bounds of 7 to 9215 days apply to dataExpirationRule.expireAfterDays, not to criteria.expireAfterDays.

verdicts.concept: Partition fields constraints for DATE rules
verdicts.claim: Partition field values are limited to a maximum of 700 characters; documents with partition field values exceeding this limit are not archived.
verdicts.evidence: The value of a partition field can be up to a maximum of 700 characters. Documents with values exceeding 700 characters are not archived.

verdicts.claim: DATE criteria selects a single date field and an age in days; only the age parameter can be modified after archive creation, not the chosen date field.
verdicts.evidence: No verbatim statement that only the age parameter can be modified.

verdicts.concept: DATE criteria field types and formats
verdicts.claim: Time series collections only support ISODATE format for the date field value in DATE criteria.
verdicts.evidence: The date field value must be in [ISODate](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/glossary/#std-term-ISODate) format.
